tools.name: playbook_create
tools.description: Create an action playbook — a trigger→action rule that claims a matching arrival from a watcher before the relevance gate judges it. The rule appears on the Automations surface and is the same list shown there.

trigger.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against an arrival's title and summary (e.g. "invoice", "review requested"). Use "*" to claim everything on the channel.

action.description: What to do when the trigger matches — natural language action description (e.g. "check calendar, propose 3 times")

name.description: Short display name for the rule (e.g. "Investor reply → draft"). Defaults to the trigger text.

channel.description: Watcher source this rule applies to: "gmail", "outlook", "google-calendar", "outlook-calendar", "github", "linear" — or "*" for all sources. Defaults to "*".

autonomy_level.description: How much autonomy: "auto" = execute automatically, "draft" = draft for review, "notify" = surface only. Defaults to "draft". The global trust dial caps this — the tool reports the effective level.

priority.description: Relative priority — higher numbers take precedence. Exactly one playbook fires per arrival. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: playbook_list
tools.description: List action playbooks, optionally filtered by channel. Shows the effective autonomy after the global trust cap and when each rule last fired.

channel.description: Filter by watcher source (e.g. "gmail", "github"). Omit to show all.

tools.name: playbook_update
tools.description: Update an existing action playbook rule

playbook_id.description: ID of the playbook to update (from playbook_list results)

channel.description: Updated watcher source ("gmail", "github", …) or "*" for all

enabled.description: Enable or disable the rule without deleting it

playbook_id.description: ID of the playbook to delete (from playbook_list results)
